summary: Reads bytes from a buffered input stream. While a requested count a3 remains, it consumes from an internal buffer (pointer at this+0x1C, remaining count at this+0x2C) when both are valid, copying via MemoryCopy_cc00; otherwise it calls the vtable method at obj+0x14 (index 5) to refill or read a single byte. Returns the total number of bytes read.

operations.description: Initialize v9 to 0, the running total of bytes read.
while (a3 > 0) — iterate until the requested byte count a3 is fully consumed.
If the buffer pointer at this+0x1C is non-null and the remaining byte count at this+0x2C is greater than 0, take the buffered-copy path.
Compute v6 = min(a3, remaining count at this+0x2C), the number of bytes available to copy this iteration.
MemoryCopy_cc00 copies v6 bytes from the internal buffer into the output buffer a2.
Advance the read state: v9 += v6, a3 -= v6, remaining count at this+0x2C -= v6, a2 += v6, and buffer pointer at this+0x1C += v6.
When the buffer path is unavailable, invoke the refill/read method stored in the vtable at obj+0x14 (index 5) on this stream object.
If the refill/read call returns -1 (EOF or error), return v9 early.
Otherwise store the returned byte into a2, advance a2, increment v9, and decrement a3.
Return v9, the total number of bytes read.
